mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where the FEDFUNDS rate increased by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3% over the last two months signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of the instances where the UNRATE decreased by more than 0.3%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over the last three months signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where RSAFS increased over three months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the last month signals a contraction in supply, which leads to higher prices and reduced corporate profitability, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of the instances where INDPRO decreased by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the last month, combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2%, signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200k & UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where both PAYEMS and UNRATE meet the trigger conditions.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% over the last two months signals easing inflationary pressures, which reduces the likelihood of aggressive monetary tightening, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of the instances where CPIAUCSL decreased by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the last three months signals a strong demand for housing, which boosts related sectors and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where HOUST increased by more than 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 0.5% over the last quarter signals a contraction in economic activity, which leads to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of the instances where GDPC1 decreased by more than 0.5%.
